branded.why: Trappist cheese, made at Scourmont Abbey since 1876, part of the monastic tradition of Belgian food.

about.text: Cheeses made by the Trappist monastery at Scourmont Abbey in Chimay since 1876, among them a beer-washed cheese whose rind is soaked in Chimay beer and an aged, hard Old Chimay matured at least six months.

sources.text: The monastery, the beer-soaked rind and the ageing, from this article.
